callees.name: os.path.abspath
callees.post_condition: Returns a normalized absolute path equivalent to path without accessing the filesystem.

callees.name: tempfile.mkdtemp
callees.pre_condition: The parent temporary directory exists and is writable.
callees.post_condition: Creates a unique directory whose name begins with prefix when prefix is non-None. Returns the absolute path to the created directory.

callees.name: subprocess.run
callees.signature: subprocess.run(args: list[str], *, check: bool, capture_output: bool, text: bool, env: dict | None) -> CompletedProcess
callees.pre_condition: args is a non-empty list of strings naming an executable and its arguments. When env is specified, it maps environment variable names to values.
callees.post_condition: Executes the command specified by args in a child process. When capture_output is true, captures stdout and stderr into the result's stdout and stderr attributes. When text is true, captured output is decoded as strings. When check is true, raises CalledProcessError if the child exits with a non-zero status. Returns a CompletedProcess whose stdout attribute is the stripped captured standard output.

callees.name: shutil.copytree
callees.signature: shutil.copytree(src: str, dst: str, *, ignore: callable | None, symlinks: bool) -> str
callees.pre_condition: src is an existing directory. dst does not exist.
callees.post_condition: Recursively copies the directory tree rooted at src to dst. When symlinks is true, symbolic links are preserved as links. When ignore is provided, entries matched by the ignore callable are excluded from the copy. Returns dst.

callees.name: os.path.isdir
callees.post_condition: Returns True if path exists and refers to a directory; False otherwise.

callees.name: os.path.exists
callees.post_condition: Returns True if path exists in the filesystem; False otherwise, including for broken symbolic links.
